title: Getting started
summary: How to join, sign in, choose your language and theme, put the app on your phone and turn on reminders.

blocks.text: FamilyHUB is only for invited people. Your family administrator sends you an invitation by email, or gives you a link. The link works once and stops working after 7 days.

items: Open the link from the invitation.
Type your name.
Choose a password with at least 12 characters. A long sentence works well and is easy to remember.
Press **Create account**. Or press **Continue with Google** if you want to sign in with the Google account that uses the same email address as the invitation.

blocks.text: If the link says it cannot be used, it has expired, was already used, or was cancelled. Ask your administrator for a new one.

items: Open the app address in your browser or start the installed app.
Type your email and password and press **Sign in**. Or press **Sign in with Google**.
Tick **Stay signed in for 30 days** only on your own device.
If you turned on two-step verification, type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or use your passkey.

blocks.text: To sign out, open the account menu (the person button in the top bar) and choose **Log out**.

Forgot your password? Press **Forgot password?** on the sign-in page, type your email and follow the link we send. The link works for 60 minutes. After you set a new password you are signed out on your other devices.
Never tick **Stay signed in** on a shared or public computer.

sections.title: Language and light or dark theme

blocks.text: The app speaks Slovak, Polish and English. You can switch at any time. The choice is remembered on this device.

items: Open the account menu in the top bar.
Under **Language**, pick your language.
Under **Theme**, pick **System** (follows your device), **Light** or **Dark**.

blocks.text: The same choices are in [Settings > Appearance and language](/settings/appearance).

sections.title: Putting the app on your phone, tablet or computer

blocks.text: FamilyHUB can be installed like an app. It then opens in its own window and gets its own icon. Nothing is downloaded from an app store. Its icon is the FamilyHUB logo: an orange, red and blue letter F.

items: Open FamilyHUB in Safari.
Tap the **Share** button.
Choose **Add to Home Screen**, then **Add**.
Open the new icon on your Home Screen.
Open FamilyHUB in Chrome.
Tap the menu button (three dots).
Choose **Install app** or **Add to Home screen**.

blocks.text: **Computer** (Chrome or Edge): look for the install icon at the right end of the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose **Install FamilyHUB**.
Menu names change a little between browser versions. If you cannot find the button, look for the word Install or Add to Home Screen.
You can get reminders about tasks, shopping lists and gift occasions by email and as short push alerts on your device.

items: Open the account menu, choose **Settings**, then **Notifications**.
Turn on **Email reminders**, **Push notifications**, or both.
For push, press **Enable push on this device** and allow notifications when your browser asks.
Press **Send test notification** to check that it works.

blocks.text: On iPhone and iPad, push only works after you add FamilyHUB to your Home Screen (see above) and open it from there.
Push alerts show only a short title such as the task title, never your notes. If both switches are off you get no reminders. Each device needs its own **Enable push** step.

A small green circle with a question mark next to a field, a section or a button explains what it is for, what to enter, or what happens when you press it. They appear only where a function is not obvious.

blocks.title: Where to look
items: On a computer, point at the question mark with the mouse. It also opens when you reach it with the Tab key.
On a phone or tablet, tap the question mark. Tap it again, tap somewhere else or press Esc to close it.
The text is shown in the language you chose for the app.

blocks.text: Only one explanation is open at a time. They never change anything: they are only help.

items: On a wide screen, the menu is on the left. On a phone, it is the bar at the bottom.
You only see the parts of the app that your administrator allowed for you.
The account menu (top bar) holds Settings, this manual, language, theme and Log out.
The **Add** button on phones lets you quickly add a new item.

blocks.text: If a page says you have no access, ask your administrator. See [who can see what](who-sees-what).
